observations.quote: There appears to be about 30 diplomatic passports and 40 official passports that were issued to persons that were not proper appointments.
observations.notes: Ombudsman's count of Vanuatu diplomatic passports issued from 1993 to the report (13 Mar 1998, reissued 18 Mar) to foreign nationals appointed as honorary consuls, trade commissioners and similar posts that the Ombudsman judges sham appointments; Table 1 lists them. The report links the issues to payments to ministers (section 3). Rounded ('about').

observations.quote: There appears to be about 30 diplomatic passports and 40 official passports that were issued to persons that were not proper appointments.
observations.notes: Official passports issued 1993 to March 1998 to persons not properly appointed (Table 2). Rounded ('about').

observations.quote: Out of 70 passports issued only 6 have been issued with a letter of acceptance from the receiving country. 64 were issued without a letter of acceptance.
observations.notes: Total of diplomatic and official passports in Tables 1 and 2 (about 30 + about 40). The tables include a few appointments the Ombudsman marks as exceptions, so 70 counts all listed passports.

observations.quote: Out of 70 passports issued only 6 have been issued with a letter of acceptance from the receiving country. 64 were issued without a letter of acceptance.
observations.notes: Passports in Tables 1-2 issued without a letter of acceptance from the receiving country (6 + 64 = 70).

observations.quote: Out of 70 passports issued only 6 have been issued with a letter of acceptance from the receiving country.
observations.notes: Passports in Tables 1-2 issued with a letter of acceptance (6 + 64 = 70).

observations.quote: under the Resort Las Vegas/SETC contract, it is contemplated that sixty thousand (60,000) - eighty thousand (80,000) citizenships are to be sold (refer clauses 5 and 6 of the contract.
observations.notes: Number of citizenships the 14 July 1997 contract between the government-appointed agent and its Australian sub-agent contemplated selling (clauses 5-6). The Ombudsman adds that one residency/citizenship can cover more than one person and speaks of 'up to one hundred and sixty thousand (160,000) citizenships in the next 10 years' (para 1.6). Status budget as a contractual plan; the scheme was found unlawful.

observations.quote: This operation will generate 280 millions of vatu each year if we give out annually 4000 passports .
observations.notes: From the Foreign Affairs Minister's memorandum approved by the Council of Ministers on 19 June 1997 for the 'Permanent Residentship & Immigration Scheme' (VT 700,000 per family). The VT 280 million is already recorded (o-a9f4295cef).

observations.quote: expected to be able to sell 10-15,000 Vanuatu citizenships in South Korea each year
observations.notes: The agent's expectation in a fax of 5 June 1997 to a Korean company (translated by the Ombudsman's Office), before its appointment as exclusive agent. Country of the buyers; nationality or residence not stated.

observations.quote: He explained that such a Vanuatu Citizenship program for 80 thousand people would bring 40 Billion VT to the Government.
observations.notes: The agent's statement recorded in a Ministry of Foreign Affairs file note of 10 June 1997 (as translated). '80 thousand' partly in words.

observations.quote: He explained that such a Vanuatu Citizenship program for 80 thousand people would bring 40 Billion VT to the Government.
observations.notes: Scale billion: recorded value 40 with scale 'billion'. The agent's claim of government revenue from a citizenship programme for 80,000 people, recorded in a Foreign Affairs file note of 10 June 1997; no period stated.

program_terms.applies_to: ordinary naturalisation (uninterrupted ordinary residence in Austria)
program_terms.quote: er seit mindestens zehn Jahren ununterbrochen seinen ordentlichen Wohnsitz im Gebiet der Republik hat;
program_terms.notes: Context row (general naturalisation law, no programme). Version of § 10 in force 31.07.1985-30.07.1993 (BGBl. Nr. 311/1985); the document does not settle whether this rule changed when the version ended, so valid_to is left empty.

program_terms.applies_to: naturalisation with a reason especially worthy of consideration (reduced uninterrupted residence; Interior Minister heard)
program_terms.quote: wenn der Fremde seit mindestens vier Jahren ununterbrochen seinen ordentlichen Wohnsitz im Gebiet der Republik hat und ein besonders berücksichtigungswürdiger Grund für die Verleihung der Staatsbürgerschaft vorliegt
program_terms.notes: Context row (general naturalisation law). Wording introduced by BGBl. Nr. 394/1973, Art. I Z 4. Version in force 31.07.1985-30.07.1993; valid_to not settled by the document.

program_terms.applies_to: naturalisation in the interest of the Republic for extraordinary (incl. economic) achievements, confirmed by the Federal Government
program_terms.quote: Die Voraussetzungen des Abs. 1 Z 1 und 7 sowie des Abs. 2 entfallen, wenn die Bundesregierung bestätigt, daß die Verleihung der Staatsbürgerschaft wegen der vom Fremden bereits erbrachten oder von ihm noch zu erwartenden außerordentlichen Leistungen, insbesondere auf wissenschaftlichen, wirtschaftlichen, künstlerischen oder sportlichen Gebieten, im Interesse der Republik liegt.
program_terms.notes: No number printed: the 10-year residence requirement (Abs. 1 Z 1), the secured-livelihood requirement (Z 7) and the requirement to give up another nationality (Abs. 2) are waived, so 0 years is implied. Provision introduced by BGBl. Nr. 394/1973, Art. I Z 5. No investment amount in the law.

program_terms.applies_to: re-issue of the permanent residence card after loss or damage
program_terms.location: VIII. Basis and Standards for Fees, (II)
program_terms.quote: Re-issuance due to loss or damage: CNY 600.
program_terms.notes: Fee applies to all permanent residence categories, including investors. English reference page (Chinese version authoritative); page dated 2023-03-27; valid_from not stated.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal of the permanent residence card on expiry
program_terms.location: VIII. Basis and Standards for Fees, (II)
program_terms.quote: Renewal upon expiration: CNY 300.
program_terms.notes: Fee applies to all permanent residence categories, including investors. English reference page (Chinese version authoritative); page dated 2023-03-27; valid_from not stated.

program_terms.applies_to: unmarried child of an eligible investor (must be under 18)
program_terms.quote: The spouse and the unmarried children (under age 18) of the applicant who meets the foregoing conditions specified in (I), (II) or (III);
program_terms.notes: Printed as 'under age 18': the child must not yet be 18. English reference page (Chinese version authoritative); page dated 2023-03-27; valid_from not stated.

program_terms.applies_to: permanent resident (status may be cancelled if residence in China is shorter without approval)
program_terms.quote: Foreign nationals whose residence in China, without approval, is less than three months each year or less than one year during the five-year residence.
program_terms.notes: Ground on which the NIA may cancel permanent residence (Art. 24 of the Measures); applies to all permanent residents, including investors. English reference page (Chinese version authoritative); page dated 2023-03-27; valid_from not stated.

program_terms.applies_to: permanent resident (status may be cancelled if residence in China is shorter without approval)
program_terms.quote: Foreign nationals whose residence in China, without approval, is less than three months each year or less than one year during the five-year residence.
program_terms.notes: Second limb of the same cancellation ground: less than one year during the five-year residence. English reference page (Chinese version authoritative); page dated 2023-03-27; valid_from not stated.

program_terms.applies_to: investigation by the processing authority after acceptance
program_terms.location: VII. Procedure and Means of Application, (II)
program_terms.quote: Processing authorities shall complete the investigation within three months from the date of acceptance and report the eligible applications to inspection authorities.
program_terms.notes: Stage deadline within the overall six-month decision period (already recorded). English reference page (Chinese version authoritative); page dated 2023-03-27; valid_from not stated.

program_terms.applies_to: review by the inspection authority
program_terms.location: VII. Procedure and Means of Application, (II)
program_terms.quote: Inspection authorities shall complete the review of relevant applications within two months and report eligible applications to NIA for approval.
program_terms.notes: Stage deadline within the overall six-month decision period. English reference page (Chinese version authoritative); page dated 2023-03-27; valid_from not stated.

program_terms.applies_to: non-Omani buyer of a built unit in an Integrated Tourism Complex in Musandam governorate (usufruct only; no freehold)
program_terms.location: Art. 1 (new text of Art. 2 of the executive regulations); Art. 3
program_terms.quote: ولا يجوز لغير العماني في المجمعات السياحية المتكاملة في محافظة مسندم إلا شراء الوحدات المبنية بنظام حق الانتفاع وبما لا تجاوز مدته (٩٩) تسعا وتسعين سنة
program_terms.notes: Maximum usufruct term, printed in digits and words. Decision issued 18 May 2022, published in Official Gazette 1443 of 29 May 2022 and in force the day after publication (Art. 3), so 30 May 2022. Copy from Qanoon.om (not an official source).

program_terms.applies_to: investor, personally or through a company he runs or holds at least 30% of; investment in tangible or intangible fixed assets in France, made or committed
program_terms.location: R. 421-35, 2° (Décret n°2025-539 du 13 juin 2025, art. 3); also Annexe 10, item 11
program_terms.quote: 2° Effectuer ou s'engager à effectuer sur le territoire français un investissement en immobilisations corporelles ou incorporelles d'au moins 300 000 euros.
program_terms.notes: Card now named "talent-porteur de projet" (L. 421-16, 3°). The document annex (Annexe 10, item 11) restates the EUR 300,000 and 30% conditions under the older name "passeport talent" and article L. 421-18. Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: investor investing through a company (must run it or hold at least 30% of its capital)
program_terms.location: R. 421-35, first paragraph (Décret n°2025-539 du 13 juin 2025, art. 3)
program_terms.quote: personnellement ou par l'intermédiaire d'une société qu'il dirige ou dont il détient au moins 30 % du capital
program_terms.notes: Card "talent-porteur de projet", L. 421-16, 3°. Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: investor: create or save jobs, or commit to, within four years of the investment
program_terms.quote: 1° Créer ou sauvegarder ou s'engager à créer ou sauvegarder de l'emploi dans les quatre années qui suivent l'investissement sur le territoire français ;
program_terms.notes: Card "talent-porteur de projet", L. 421-16, 3°. Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: investor: the investment or commitment must start within one year of the card being issued, or the card is withdrawn
program_terms.quote: 1° L'opération ou l'engagement mentionné à l'article R. 421-35 ayant motivé sa délivrance ne connaît aucun début d'exécution dans un délai d'un an suivant la date de délivrance de cette carte ;
program_terms.notes: Withdrawal ground; R. 421-36, 2° also withdraws the card if the funds come from illegal activities. Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: multi-year card "talent-porteur de projet" issued for a direct economic investment in France
program_terms.location: L. 421-16, first paragraph and 3° (LOI n°2024-42 du 26 janvier 2024, art. 30)
program_terms.quote: Se voit délivrer une carte de séjour pluriannuelle portant la mention “ talent-porteur de projet ” d'une durée maximale de quatre ans, l'étranger qui se trouve dans l'une des situations suivantes :
program_terms.notes: The card was earlier named "passeport talent"; the renaming came with LOI n°2024-42. Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: spouse of the card holder, for the "passeport talent (famille)" card (duration equal to the remaining validity of the holder's card)
program_terms.location: L. 421-22, first paragraph (LOI n°2025-391 du 30 avril 2025, art. 40)
program_terms.quote: S'il est âgé d'au moins dix-huit ans, le conjoint de l'étranger mentionné aux articles L. 421-9, L. 421-11 et L. 421-13-1 à L. 421-21 se voit délivrer une carte de séjour pluriannuelle portant la mention " passeport talent (famille) " d'une durée égale à la période de validité restant à courir de la carte de séjour de son conjoint.
program_terms.notes: Covers the spouse of an L. 421-16 card holder (within L. 421-13-1 to L. 421-21). Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: family member holding the "passeport talent (famille)" card who has resided in France at least five years (renewed as of right)
program_terms.location: L. 421-22, third paragraph (LOI n°2025-391 du 30 avril 2025, art. 40)
program_terms.quote: Elle est renouvelée de plein droit pour une durée de quatre ans lorsque son titulaire réside en France depuis au moins cinq ans.
program_terms.notes: Family card of investors and other talent card holders. Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: first issue of a residence permit (tax on the residence permit; applies to the investor card)
program_terms.quote: I. - La première délivrance d'un titre de séjour donne lieu à la perception d'une taxe dont le montant est fixé à 300 euros.
program_terms.notes: General residence-permit tax that applies to the investor card: the reduced amounts in L. 436-1 list other articles, not L. 421-16. Wording from Loi n°2026-103 du 19 février 2026, art. 128 (V). Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal of a residence permit (tax on the residence permit; applies to the investor card)
program_terms.quote: II. - Le renouvellement d'un titre de séjour donne lieu à la perception d'une taxe dont le montant est fixé à 200 euros.
program_terms.notes: General residence-permit tax that applies to the investor card: the reduced amounts in L. 436-1 list other articles, not L. 421-16. Wording from Loi n°2026-103 du 19 février 2026, art. 128 (V). Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: duplicate of a residence permit (same tax as first issue for the same ground)
program_terms.quote: La fourniture de duplicata donne lieu à la perception d'une taxe du même montant que celle applicable lors de la première délivrance du titre de séjour pour le même motif.
program_terms.notes: No figure printed in L. 436-2 itself: it sets the duplicate tax equal to the first-issue tax (EUR 300 in L. 436-1, I), so the amount is implied. General residence-permit tax that applies to the investor card: the reduced amounts in L. 436-1 list other articles, not L. 421-16. Wording from Loi n°2026-103 du 19 février 2026, art. 128 (V). Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: issue, renewal, duplicate or change of a residence card (stamp duty, on top of the residence-permit tax)
program_terms.quote: la délivrance, le renouvellement, le duplicata ou le changement d'une carte de séjour ou d'un titre équivalent prévu par les traités ou accords internationaux sont soumis à un droit de timbre d'un montant de 50 euros.
program_terms.notes: General stamp duty that applies to the investor card. Wording from Loi n°2026-103 du 19 février 2026, art. 128 (V). Consolidated code, edition 2026-09-21 (last modification 2026-08-27), unofficial reproduction of Légifrance; the in-force date of this wording is not printed, so valid_from is empty.

program_terms.applies_to: property in a municipality with GDP per capita below the national average, paid with money transferred from abroad (escudo equivalent of EUR 80,000)
program_terms.quote: Valor igual ou superior a €80.000 (oitenta mil euros), correspondente a 8.821.200$00(oito milhões, oitocentos e vinte e um mil e duzentos escudos)
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Escudo equivalent printed beside the euro amount; restates the Law 30/IX/2018 escudo figure.

program_terms.applies_to: property in a municipality with GDP per capita at or above the national average, paid with money transferred from abroad (escudo equivalent of EUR 120,000)
program_terms.quote: Valor igual ou superior a €120.000 (cento e vinte mil euros), correspondente a 13.231.800$00 (treze milhões, duzentos e trinta e um mil, e oitocentos escudos)
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Where GDP per capita by municipality cannot be calculated, GDP per capita by island is used (art. 2(2)).

program_terms.applies_to: Green Card (renewal interval for the first renewals)
program_terms.quote: O Green Card é renovável de 5 em 5 anos, e por 10 anos a partir da segunda renovação.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Restates the Law 30/IX/2018 rule.

program_terms.applies_to: Green Card renewals from the second renewal onwards
program_terms.quote: O Green Card é renovável de 5 em 5 anos, e por 10 anos a partir da segunda renovação.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal of a Green Card may be requested from 90 days before expiry
program_terms.quote: O pedido de renovação de Green Card pode ser solicitado pelo interessado a partir dos 90 dias anteriores à caducidade do título.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: applicant must remedy a defect in the application after notice from the DEF, or the file is archived
program_terms.quote: no prazo máximo de dois dias úteis, suprir a falta, sob pena de arquivamento do processo.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: Green Card refused to anyone convicted, in Cabo Verde or abroad, of a crime carrying a prison sentence of two years or more
program_terms.quote: Aos condenados, no país ou no exterior, por crime a que corresponda pena de prisão igual ou superior a dois anos;
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Restates the Law 30/IX/2018 rule. For renewal the applicant must also show no sentence(s) above one year of prison (art. 11(4)(e)).

program_terms.applies_to: minor under 14 (and/or dependant) in the holder's care, for family reunification
program_terms.quote: O menor de catorze anos e ou dependente que esteja a seu cargo no exercício do poder paternal, tutela ou curatela.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. "Under 14" (menor de catorze anos).

program_terms.applies_to: Cabo Verde criminal record required if the applicant has lived in Cabo Verde at least six months before applying
program_terms.quote: Registo criminal de Cabo Verde, caso o requerente tenha vivido em Cabo Verde, pelo menos seis meses antes do pedido
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: holder of the family reunification right is notified of the approval
program_terms.quote: O titular do direito ao reagrupamento familiar é notificado do despacho de deferimento no prazo de oito dias
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: family members covered by an approved family reunification must apply for a residence visa at the consulate, or the approval lapses
program_terms.quote: devem dirigir à Missão Diplomática ou Posto Consular de carreira da respetiva área de residência, no prazo de noventa dias, a fim de formalizarem o pedido de visto de residência.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: residents must notify the DEF of changes in civil status, nationality, profession, domicile, or absence from the country for more than 90 days
program_terms.quote: Os residentes devem comunicar a DEF, no prazo de oito dias contados da data em que ocorra, a alteração do seu estado civil da sua nacionalidade, da sua profissão, do domicílio e da ausência do país por período superior a noventa dia.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: absence from the country longer than this must be notified to the DEF within 8 days
program_terms.quote: e da ausência do país por período superior a noventa dia.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. A notification duty, not a limit that ends the status.

program_terms.applies_to: receipt for a renewal application has the same effect as the Green Card, renewable
program_terms.quote: O recibo do pedido de renovação de Green Card, produz os mesmos efeitos que o Green Card durante um prazo de oito dias, renovável.
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37.

program_terms.applies_to: fraudulent use of the Green Card (administrative fine, minimum; maximum 15,000,000$00)
program_terms.quote: constitui contraordenação punida com coima entre 5.000.000$00 (cinco milhões de escudos) e 15.000.000$00 (quinze milhões de escudos).
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Range 5,000,000-15,000,000 escudos; besides cancellation of the card and criminal penalties. Restates the Law 30/IX/2018 art. 11 fine.

program_terms.applies_to: false documents or declarations to obtain or renew a Green Card, forged cards, sham marriage or adoption for family reunification, or selling the qualifying property without asking the DEF to cancel the card (fine minimum; maximum 15,000,000$00)
program_terms.quote: É punido com coima de 12.000.000$00 (doze milhões de escudos) a 15.000.000$00 (quinze milhões de escudos) quem:
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Range 12,000,000-15,000,000 escudos; covers art. 22(3)(a)-(f), including (f) "O titular de Green Card que alienar o património que deu origem à aquisição de Green Card e não proceda imediatamente à DEF, requerendo o seu cancelamento."

program_terms.applies_to: Green Card holder who obstructs enquiries into grounds for losing the card (fine minimum; maximum 12,000,000$00)
program_terms.quote: É punido com coima de 10.000.000$00 (dez milhões de escudos) a 12.000.000$00 (doze milhões de escudos), o titular de Green Card que obstar as diligências
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Range 10,000,000-12,000,000 escudos.

program_terms.applies_to: using the Green Card for purposes other than those in Law 30/IX/2018 (fine minimum; maximum 8,000,000$00)
program_terms.quote: É punido com coima de 5.000.000$00 (cinco milhões de escudos) a 8.000.000$00 (oito milhões de escudos) quem, utilizar o Green Card para outros fins
program_terms.notes: Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2020 in force the day after publication (7 Jan 2020), art. 37. Range 5,000,000-8,000,000 escudos.

program_terms.applies_to: share of the 5,000$00 Green Card fee for production and personalisation of the Green Card
program_terms.notes: Portaria conjunta 61/2021 in force the day after publication (30 Dec 2021), art. 11; Annex II replaced by Portaria conjunta 25/2022 (in force 17 Jun 2022), so valid_to 2022-06-16. The five Green Card shares as printed add up to 5,200$00, not the printed total of 5,000$00 (a discrepancy in the source).

events.title: Panama lets any number of foreigners apply for permanent forestry investor residence through one company, if each invests the minimum
events.description: Decree 199 of 2021 rewrites art. 181 of Decree 320 of 2008: where the investment is made through a company, every foreigner may apply for the permanent forestry investor permit provided each made the minimum investment of art. 180. Full consolidated French immigration code (CESEDA, legislative and regulatory parts, edition 2026-09-21), mostly outside scope (asylum, removal, detention, penalties, other permit categories). In scope: L. 421-16, 3° and R. 421-35/36 on the multi-year "talent-porteur de projet" card for a direct economic investment (EUR 300,000 in fixed assets, 30% company ownership, jobs within four years, withdrawal if not started within a year), L. 421-22 family card, the residence-permit taxes and stamp duty (L. 436-1, L. 436-2, L. 436-7) and Annex 10 item 11 (documents for the investor card, restating EUR 300,000 and 30%). The rest of the issue (INE statutes, water emergency resolution, two rectifications) is out of scope. This pass added 18 rules: escudo thresholds, renewal intervals and window, correction and notification deadlines, refusal threshold, child age, family visa deadline, absence notification, renewal receipt, and the four fine bands.

Rest of the issue (three tourism zoning plans) out of scope. This pass added 11 rules: the 10 fee-split amounts (Annex II; the Green Card shares as printed sum to 5,200$00 against a printed total of 5,000$00) and the card delivery period.

PDF pp. 32-33: Portaria conjunta 25/2022, first amendment of Portaria 61/2021: the 5,000$00 / 2,000$00 Green Card and family reunification amounts become processing fees for the residence authorisation (amounts unchanged); the card (TRE) fee is left to Decreto-lei 23/2020; new split of the fee between reception, analysis and decision, and SITRE maintenance (Annex II); card delivery from the 15th working day; Annex III form revoked. The residence permit extension fee (ordinary 500 USD) is not said to apply to investors, so it is not recorded as an investor rule; other permits and visas are out of scope. Earlier passes had the two investor fees; this pass added the duplicate-permit fee (1 rule).

Department of Immigration Zimbabwe permits page (modified 12 May 2025) listing requirements for scholars, students, investor residence, temporary employment and spouse permits. In scope: the investor residence permit (initial) requirements: project proposal, proof of funds for transfer, equipment, employee list, company documents, police clearance not older than six months, fee US$500 plus US$300 per dependant. The 'Investor Residence Permit Extension' heading has no content on the page. No minimum investment is printed. Other permits are out of scope. Earlier passes had the two fees; this pass added the police clearance period (1 rule).

Zambia Development Agency Act 2022 (Act 17 of 2022; assented 10 Nov 2022, published 16 Nov 2022, commenced 13 Jan 2023): continues the Agency, sets its functions, Board, funds, offences (penalty units) and repeals the ZDA Act 2006 with savings provisions. It contains no investor residence or immigration rule and no investment threshold; its only in-scope content is the repeal of the 2006 Act (whose s. 65 linked investment to residence), already recorded as an event. This pass added nothing.

Investment, Trade and Business Development Act 2022 (Act 18 of 2022; published 16 Nov 2022, commenced 13 Jan 2023; this version valid to 17 Apr 2024): investment licences, permits and certificates of registration (5-year validity), investor guarantees and repatriation, investment incentives (s. 30: tax incentives for a local investor from USD 50,000, citizen-owned company USD 100,000, citizen empowerment company USD 150,000, citizen-influenced company USD 500,000, or any investor USD 1 million), special economic zones, trade and business development. It has no immigration or residence provision: its 'permit' is a business permit and its thresholds earn tax incentives, not residence, so nothing belongs in the tables (decision 15). Its commencement is already noted in the ZDA Act repeal event. This pass added nothing.

ZambiaLII page (capture of 4 Nov 2025) with the consolidated Immigration and Deportation Act 2010 (Act 18 of 2010; commenced 17 Sep 2010; version as amended by Act 19 of 2016 on 7 Jun 2016): definitions, entry, residence permit (s. 20: investor's permit holders eligible after more than three years; dependant age, cessation rules), temporary residence permits, investor's permit (s. 29: prescribed investment or ZDA licence, family employment, minimum citizen employees prescribed, address-change fine), prohibited immigrants, savings (s. 62: self-employment permit holders to convert within six months). In scope: the investor's permit and the residence permit route open to its holders. The Act sets no investment amount (left to regulations). The 2016 amendments shown (s. 20(2)(c), (g), (7)) do not touch the investor provisions. Earlier passes recorded the Act's commencement from the separately stored 2010 Act; this pass added 7 rules (3-year residence eligibility, dependant age, entry deadline, two absence limits, address-change fine, transitional conversion window).
